properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.77.0): through the `--call` door, argument shapes are learned one refusal at a time. The door holds every tool's full input schema and prints none of it, find_tools returns top-level parameter names only, and no served tool returns a schema. For 5 of the 6 shape frictions in the report, the shape IS in the published schema, so the cause is the door, not the tool
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triage agent B, item L5 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02. Binary 0.77.0 (target/release), scratch stores only, main's export imported for reads. Logs: /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-B/calls.log, tools_list_g1.json, nested_required.txt.

① OBSERVED (the report): "find_tools gives parameter names only ... nested argument shapes (link items, verification targets, affected-node lists) and the allowed relation names are still learned one refusal at a time". Five writes each needed at least one refused attempt; one Decision with one link took four calls.

② PRECEDENT, so this is a RECURRENCE, not a new cause:
- fact:the-contract-is-the-toolsnaps-and-no-served-tool-will-hand-a-session-one-tools-input-schema (2026-09-19, flo2 F21) says the same residue: no served way to read one tool's inputSchema.
- req:the-cli-describes-any-tool-with-its-full-schema-and-lessons (proposed) is the planned fix, step 4 of epoch:planned-the-call-door-works-for-an-agent-that-cannot-use-mcp.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the door discards the schema it holds; (b) find_tools strips it; (c) the shapes are missing from the published schemas, so a tool cause; (d) refusals do not teach the shape; (e) the observation is wrong and a route exists.

⑤ MEASURED.
- find_tools items carry exactly {tool, score, summary (the first sentence), parameters (the top-level property NAMES)}. The reply adds {count, matched, omitted, searched, query}. It searches 193 of the 195 tools served over stdio tools/list (the 2 deprecated ones are excluded).
- Candidate (e) is REFUTED. None of the 195 input schemas takes a tool name, get_skill refuses one ("no skill named 'add_decision'"), and describe_schema answers for node and edge TYPES only. Yet find_tools' own description tells the caller to "read its full schema, once you know its name", and nothing under --call lets it.
- Candidate (a) is CONFIRMED in code: call_one_tool runs `probe.tools_with_lessons()` (main.rs:750) only to find the tool and its read_only_hint.
- Candidate (c), per friction, read from the schema an MCP client receives over stdio tools/list from the same binary:
  - add_decision: the relation enum (13 values) and evidence's description are in $defs.RelationLinkReq.
  - set_artifact_checksums: the three disposition values are in the DESCRIPTION of $defs.ChecksumAcceptReq.disposition. They are prose, not an enum (`type: string`).
  - record_finding: basis is enum [measured, forecast].
  - coverage_report: observed's description gives `{ "path": ..., "mass": ... }`.
  - add_epoch: the ONE that is absent everywhere. The schema says `required: ["id"]` and `sequence` has no description (chg:required-to-create-optional-to-revise).
  So 5 of 6 are the door and 1 is the tool.
- Size: 16 of 195 tools carry nested $defs shapes, with 35 required nested fields between them.
- Candidate (d) is PARTLY CONFIRMED. Wrong-VALUE refusals name the legal values in one round trip (relation, disposition, basis). The missing NESTED field refusal says the schema "publishes no description" when it does (fact:root-cause-a-missing-nested-field-refusal-says-the-schema-publishes-no-description-when-it-does-2026-10-02). coverage_report given strings answers with a bare deserialize error that names neither the tool nor the field.

⑥ CLASS: the door reaches the CALL path and not the LISTING path. Everything reflow2 delivers at tools/list is invisible through it: schemas, enums, nested shapes and lessons (L6). Fixing find_tools alone would not have stopped the 2026-09-19 report. That report was in-session, where a client may also hide schemas (deferred tools).

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the reporter's counts (five writes, four calls for one Decision). There was no session log to re-measure them; they are consistent with the mechanisms above.
